newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian navy denies submarine trouble.
newsitem.headline: Russian navy denies submarine trouble.

text.p: A Russian nuclear submarine was limping back to base on Saturday after breaking down but the navy said it had only minor engine trouble.
"This does not even need any special comment," said a Russian navy spokesman. "The situation is under full control."
Earlier, Interfax news agency said the submarine, part of the Far East fleet, was heading slowly back home after breaking down "outside Russia's territorial waters".
The agency quoted a regional civil defence spokesman as saying he had been told by fleet commanders that there was no radiation leak.
It did not name the submarine or give any other details on where it was operating.
